title: free-disk-space settings
description: Environment variables and the flags whose defaults shape what the binary touches. Every flag and its default is also in `free-disk-space <command> --help`. Nothing here is secret.

entities.title: Scan state path
entities.summary: Where the scan state database lives; --state on new, resume, status, list, compress and dedupe overrides it.
entities.details: Read when clap builds the --state default; the parent directory is created on first open.

entities.title: Home directory
entities.summary: HOME locates the default state file, the clean progress file, the default scan root, the cache folders, ~/Downloads, ~/.Trash, the default dev root and the launchd plist and log.

entities.title: Executable search path
entities.summary: PATH decides whether git, brew and docker are found and which lsof, ps, pgrep, git and docker run; tools named by absolute path (ditto, xattr, osascript, launchctl, lsof in compress) are not looked up.
entities.details: The installed login item runs with PATH set in its plist to Homebrew's and the system's bin directories.

entities.title: Force macOS-only steps elsewhere
entities.summary: When set, compress, dedupe --apply and the Finder trash step run off macOS, where clonefile is a plain copy; meant for tests.

entities.title: Tool directory override
entities.summary: When set, every tool the code names by absolute path (/usr/bin/ditto, /usr/bin/xattr, /usr/sbin/lsof, /usr/bin/osascript, /bin/launchctl, and brew once found on PATH) is run from this directory instead, by file name; it exists so tests can fake macOS tools.
entities.details: It is read in release builds too, so whoever sets it in the environment chooses which programs the compress, dedupe, trash and daemon steps run.

entities.title: No colour
entities.summary: When set, output has no ANSI colours even on a terminal; off a terminal it never has them.

entities.title: Scan thresholds
entities.summary: new --root (default the home directory), --min-size (1M), --min-age-days (14) and --min-savings-pct (25) decide where the scan looks and what becomes a candidate; --cross-devices and --exclude widen or narrow it.
entities.scope: per scan; stored in the state file's meta cfg and reused by resume
entities.validation: --root must be a directory; --min-size must parse as a size (K, M, G, T suffixes, binary multiples).

entities.title: Compression safety margins
entities.summary: compress --min-age-days (14) re-checks age, --min-gain (64K) is the least verified saving worth keeping, and --reserve (2G) is free space kept beyond the temp copy.
entities.validation: --min-gain and --reserve must parse as sizes; clap refuses the command line otherwise.

entities.title: Dev root
entities.summary: The tree the dev target searches for build artifacts.
entities.type: command-line flag (directory; a leading ~ is expanded)
entities.scope: per run; for the installed daemon, fixed in the plist

entities.title: Docker stop grace
entities.summary: Seconds each running container is given to stop before Docker Desktop is asked to quit.
entities.scope: per run; the daemon always uses 30

entities.title: Daemon threshold
entities.summary: Free space below which the daemon cleans: a size, or a percentage of the data volume.
entities.scope: per daemon; written into the plist at install
entities.validation: A size must be positive; a percentage must be between 0 and 100, exclusive.

entities.title: Daemon cadence
entities.summary: Awake time between checks: seconds, minutes or hours; a bare number is minutes.
entities.scope: per daemon; written into the plist at install
entities.validation: Must be a positive number with an optional s, m or h suffix.

entities.title: Daemon targets
entities.summary: What the daemon cleans when below the threshold; any clean target, all included.
entities.scope: per daemon; written into the plist at install
